summary: The built-in production wildcard list is removed, wildcard resolution requires AUTH_ENV=development with at most one configured domain, persisted overrides cannot bypass the empty production configuration, and tests cover rejection of unregistered former-wildcard subdomains.

evidence: src/auth_config.ts lines 131-162 make wildcardClientDomains empty by default and require AUTH_ENV=development for at most one configured wildcard domain.
src/http.ts lines 113-121 and src/auth_config.ts lines 177-183 prevent a persisted hub override from enabling wildcards when production configuration is empty.
src/config_test.ts lines 421-436 and src/handler_test.ts lines 2782-2798 prove unregistered clients on former shared subdomains are rejected.
README.md lines 15-20 inventory the migrated consumers and document the managed-registry requirement.
